Name: Colored Crystalariums
Author: sophiesalacia
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/80EBfdr.png[/img][/center]
[i][center]by sophie[/center]



[/i][img]https://imgur.com/txXAhJ4.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*][size=3][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://imgur.com/sDABBoV.png[/img]

[list]
[*][size=3]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5 on Windows. Linux/Mac have not been tested, but[/size]
[size=3] should work.Please report any issues you encounter.[/size][*][size=3]Works in single player and multiplayer. Multiplayer has not been extensively [/size]
[size=3]tested, so please report any issues you encounter.
[/size][/list][list]
[*][size=3]Not compatible with AT yet - only use one crystalarium texture at a time if you don't want there to be issues.[/size]
[*][size=3]There is an optional file included for compatibility if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Gwen's Medieval Craftables[/url]﻿.[/size]
[/list]
[img]https://imgur.com/gehBk46.png[/img]

[list]
[*]There is one config option. "Draw Simplified Gem Bubbles" removes the speech-bubble-like underlay that hovers over the crystalarium when it is finished, leaving just the gem floating above. This defaults to False, drawing the bubbles in the vanilla fashion.
[/list][list]
[*]See the optional file for an example of how to modify the overlay to work with any crystalarium retexture. Basically you just need to point [font=Courier New]sophie.ColoredCrystalariums/Overlay [font=Arial]to the overlay file you wish to use. The overlay works as follows: transparent pixels are ignored, any other pixels are colored according to the gem color.[/font][/font]
[*][font=Arial]Gem colors can be customized as well - to do so, add an entry to [font=Courier New]sophie.ColoredCrystalariums/ColorOverrides[font=Arial] where the key is the object ID [/font][/font][/font]﻿﻿and the value is a string of RGB values in hex format - i.e. FFFFFF for white, FF0000 for Red, and so on. Here is an example patch which colors Diamond-filled crystalariums yellow:
[code] ﻿{
﻿ ﻿﻿"Action": "EditData",
﻿ ﻿"Target": "sophie.ColoredCrystalariums/ColorOverrides",
﻿ ﻿"Entries": {
﻿ ﻿ ﻿"72": "FFFF00" ﻿// sets Diamond (id 72) to hex color #FFFF00
﻿ ﻿}
﻿}
[/code][/list][list]
[*]If this value is not provided, the mod will calculate the average color of the sprite, meaning it should work fine with gem retextures.
[/list]
[img]https://imgur.com/YimGDMd.png[/img]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14416]Splash Text[/url]﻿ - adds a little splash of fun to the title menu
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14377]Lasting Conversation Topics[/url]﻿ -  NPCs don't immediately forget what you've done
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9659]Stats As Tokens[/url]﻿ - adds additional tokens for use with Content Patcher mods
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9444]Configurable Bundle Costs[/url]﻿ - makes the Vault/Joja bundle costs configurable
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8690]Configurable Special Orders Unlock[/url]﻿ - allows you to choose when the special orders board unlocks
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8450]Early Community Upgrades[/url]﻿ - allows you to unlock the community upgrades earlier
[/list]
